tasks.prompt: Two workers: W1 is free for 20 minutes, W2 for 30 minutes. Tasks: A takes 20 minutes, B takes 5, C takes 15. Assign every task to a worker without exceeding their free time. Return ONLY JSON: {"assignments": [{"task": "A", "worker": "W1"}]}. Include all three tasks.

Schedule tasks A(3h, skill x), B(2h, skill y), C(4h, skill x), D(1h, skill y), E(2h, skill x) on workers W1(skill x), W2(skill y), W3(skills x and y).
